subtasks.instructions: Compute the February 2025 departure delay rate for each carrier (WN, DL, AA, UA, B6, AS), returning one percentage per carrier rounded to 1 decimal. Use the documented definition: delayed means departure delay >15 minutes; delay rate = delayed completed flights / completed (non-cancelled) flights, with cancelled flights excluded from both numerator and denominator. Deduplicate repeated records by flight_id if any. For AA, B6, DL, UA, and WN, date/sched_dep/actual_dep are local at the origin; include flights whose scheduled local departure date is in February 2025. For AS, fields ending in _utc are UTC: use airports.csv and the origin airport's utc_offset_hours to convert scheduled and actual departure timestamps to local origin time, and select flights by local scheduled departure date in February 2025. Compute elapsed-minute actual minus scheduled, allowing actual departure after midnight and treating early departures as negative. Exclude cancelled flights (actual_dep may be empty). Verify denominators and numerators for every carrier and report them alongside the requested rates so the result can be checked. Do not use weather data.
